name: orbit
description: Orbit — Build Your Path. Become Career-Ready. An agentic career & personal growth platform.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @orbit/shared build && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @orbit/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @orbit/api dev" "pnpm --filter @orbit/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @orbit/shared build && pnpm --filter @orbit/api build && pnpm --filter @orbit/web build
scripts.infra:up:ai: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d ollama langflow
scripts.ollama:pull: docker exec orbit-ollama ollama pull granite3.3:2b && docker exec orbit-ollama ollama pull nomic-embed-text
